text:
Plan Orchard's 24 modules and produce the work plan.

Fixed: ledger.retry_limit=6, billing.max_workers=22, sync.retry_limit=5, scheduler.retry_limit=9, scheduler.timeout_s=50, auth.retry_limit=3, export.retry_limit=7, export.timeout_s=75, backup.retry_limit=5, metrics.max_workers=14, metrics.batch_size=550, inventory.ttl_s=150, alerts.ttl_s=600, reports.batch_size=900, media.queue_depth=150, profile.queue_depth=340.

Bounds: media.timeout_s≥120, alerts.timeout_s≥120, audit.queue_depth≤30, notify.batch_size≥800, sync.ttl_s≥540, gateway.max_workers≥28, webhooks.batch_size≥850, reports.max_workers≥30.

Dependencies: billing→sync; archive→billing; profile→sync; quota→billing; backup→quota; shipping→ledger, checkout; media→scheduler.

Forbidden (direct or transitive): audit→billing; metrics→billing; backup→webhooks; metrics→alerts.

Order: reports before gateway and backup; checkout and webhooks before quota.

Owners: alpha—notify, export, profile; beta—webhooks, reports, checkout, audit, sync.

Files: worker.py→shipping; retry.py→alerts; locks.py→export; types.py, hooks.py→archive; serial.py→inventory; loader.py→upload; policy.py→billing.

Same worker: auth+catalog; export+upload; alerts+media; scheduler+tenant.

Separate workers: catalog/upload; media/upload; audit/backup; scheduler/sync.

Everything else is team judgment.
